subject: general
question: What is the title of the book written on Rohit Sharma by R. Kaushik?

options.text: The Rise of the Hitman: The Rohit Sharma Story

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**The Rise of the Hitman: The Rohit Sharma Story**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• "A Treatise for the Remarkable Rohit" Chronicles Cricket Icon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Rohit Sharma’s journey** from **Borivali lanes to global cricket stardom** is detailed in a new book.

 
 
• 
 
The biography, titled ***The Rise of the Hitman: The Rohit Sharma Story***, is authored by **R. Kaushik**.

 
 
• 
 
The book captures **Rohit's cricketing achievements**, **struggles**, and **personal growth**.

 
 
• 
 
Known for his **elegant batting** and **calm leadership**, Rohit is one of **India’s most beloved cricketers**.

 
 
• 
 
It includes **first-hand accounts** from **teammates, coaches, and friends**, offering an **intimate portrait** of the man behind the game.

 
 
• 
 
Author **R. Kaushik** is a **veteran cricket journalist**, renowned for his **decades of insightful reporting** on Indian cricket.

 
 
• 
 
The book presents Rohit’s journey with a **warm and personal narrative style**.
